description: Write a structured spec before code (agent-skills, replaces speckit)

Use the spec-driven-development skill (`.github/skills/spec-driven-development/SKILL.md`).
Ask clarifying questions (objective, users, acceptance criteria, constraints, boundaries incl. ClearDue approval gate + credits + secrets policy), then write SPEC.md and wait for approval. Do NOT use speckit/`.specify` (retired).
